items.reply: The unchanged warning becomes reachable for every nonempty SQL expression passed to NewSQLCommand because this PR changes TablesList to use a stub whose RunCommands always fails. Previously, valid queries referencing tables logged their SQL only at debug level; they now expose it at warning level. The path remains reachable through buildCMDNode → UnmarshalSQLCommand when expressionParser is disabled. Thus the PR introduces broader raw-SQL logging despite leaving the logging statement unchanged; sensitive literals create a conditional security weakness.
